## 1. Nutritional Overview

**Recommended Daily Calorie Range:** 1,600 – 1,800 kcal/day

**Macronutrient Targets:**
| Macronutrient | Target | Notes |
|---------------|--------|-------|
| Carbohydrates | 40–45% (160–200g) | Focus on complex, low-GI carbs |
| Protein | 25–30% (100–120g) | Plant-based sources: lentils, tofu, paneer |
| Fat | 25–30% (44–60g) | Healthy fats: nuts, seeds, olive oil |

**Key Micronutrients to Prioritise:**
- **Magnesium** – regulates blood sugar (found in spinach, almonds)
- **Potassium** – supports blood pressure (found in banana, sweet potato)
- **Chromium** – improves insulin sensitivity (found in broccoli, barley)
- **Vitamin D** – supports insulin function; supplement if needed
- **Fibre** – minimum 30g/day to slow glucose absorption

## 3. Foods to Emphasise

| Food | Reason |
|------|--------|
| Bitter gourd (karela) | Natural blood sugar regulation |
| Fenugreek seeds (methi) | Improves insulin sensitivity |
| Amla (Indian gooseberry) | Blood sugar control + Vitamin C |
| Spinach | Magnesium, iron, low calorie |
| Lentils (all varieties) | High protein + fibre, low GI |
| Walnuts | Omega-3, heart-healthy |
| Brown rice/Bajra | Lower GI than white rice |
| Turmeric | Anti-inflammatory, supports metabolism |
| Cinnamon | Helps lower blood sugar naturally |
| Jamun (Indian blackberry) | Traditionally known for blood sugar control |

---

## 4. Foods to Avoid or Limit

| Food | Reason |
|------|--------|
| White rice & white bread | High GI – rapid blood sugar spike |
| Sugary beverages, juices | Direct glucose load, dangerous for T2 diabetes |
| Pickles, papads, packaged snacks | Very high sodium – raises blood pressure |
| Deep-fried snacks (samosa, jalebi) | Trans fats + high GI carbs |
| Full-fat dairy | Saturated fat + sodium concerns |
| Table salt excess | Hypertension risk; limit to < 2g/day |
| Processed cereals | Added sugar and refined carbs |
| Alcohol | Interferes with blood sugar regulation |

---

## 5. Hydration & Lifestyle Tips

- **Water:** Aim for 2.5 – 3 litres per day; begin each morning with 2 glasses of warm water
- **Green tea:** 2 cups daily; improves insulin sensitivity
- **Avoid:** Sugary drinks, excessive chai with sugar, cold carbonated drinks
- **Sleep:** 7–8 hours per night; poor sleep worsens insulin resistance
- **Activity:** 30 minutes of brisk walking 5× per week; yoga (pranayama) for stress & BP
- **Meal timing:** Eat every 3–4 hours; avoid skipping meals to prevent glucose dips
- **Stress:** Practice mindfulness or meditation; stress raises cortisol and blood sugar
